rationale: The assistant correctly identified the AirDry feature as normal operation in a single turn, matching the hidden truth exactly, and explained how to deactivate it via the settings menu while sensibly deferring the exact button sequence to the manual. It appropriately declined to diagnose a faulty catch and gave clear, correct conditions ('opens mid-wash', 'won't latch') under which warranty contact would be justified. The summary 'every time, and only by a few inches' is a fair reading of 'keeps opening... a few inches', not fabrication. Only minor gap is no mention of hot steam/door with children, though the customer had not raised children at that point.
